# Spark Control Center 1.2.3

This patch completes alert timestamp delivery and namespace-scoped rule editing.

## Fixes

- Return the persisted PostgreSQL `firstSeenAt` and `lastSeenAt` values from every alert upsert.
- Send Webhooks with the persisted alert object instead of the pre-insert object.
- Deliver enabled rule Webhooks on every non-silenced matching evaluation so receivers observe refreshed `lastSeenAt` values; the configured alert evaluation interval controls delivery frequency.
- Populate the alert-rule namespace selector from the configured cluster namespaces when an administrator has unrestricted namespace access.
- Preserve namespace restrictions for administrators with explicit assignments, while an empty rule selection continues to mean all permitted namespaces.
- Normalize empty alert-rule namespace arrays and inactive-alert resolution at the PostgreSQL boundary.

## Release assets

- `spark-control-center-1.2.3.tar` — frontend image (`spark-control-center:1.2.3`).
- `spark-control-center-backend-1.2.3.tar` — backend image (`spark-control-center-backend:1.2.3`).
- `spark-control-center-1.2.3.tgz` — Helm chart.
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for packaged artifacts.

The image names do not contain a private registry prefix.
